correctness.rationale: For all q prime powers and n≥1, the derived ideal equals the graded one-dimensional center. If the center is even, projections are orthogonal complementary symplectic 2r- and 2(n-r)-spaces, indexed by |Sp_{2n}(q)|/(|Sp_{2r}||Sp_{2n-2r}|), with q^{2(n-r)} central graph lifts. If odd, projections are ordered Lagrangian complements: ∏_{i=1}^n(q^i+1)·q^{n(n+1)/2} choices, with q^n central lifts. Exhaustive and disjoint; symplectic lifts and central shears give one automorphism orbit each. Leading exponents yield the asymptotic. Exhaustive direct bracket tests passed for (n,q)=(1,2),(1,3),(1,4),(1,5),(2,2), including extension field F4; infinite proof is mathematical, not experimental.

value.rationale: The embedded gradings over a fixed finite field form a natural finite moduli-like parameter space not captured by equivalence-type classification. Exact counts distinguish orthogonal symplectic and ordered Lagrangian pieces and show asymptotic almost-sure odd-center parity at fixed rank. The complete stratification yields automorphism-orbit sizes for all ranks, including characteristic two. The inner-adjoint restriction quantifies a construction-method boundary, not presented as an independent deep obstruction. Meaningful even though derivable using earlier structural methods.
